query:
INSERT IGNORE INTO vehicle_verifications (vehicleId, status, crlvStatus, ownershipMatchStatus)
SELECT id, 'pending', 'pending', 'pending'
FROM vehicles
WHERE crlvUrl IS NOT NULL AND crlvUrl != '';
